lpPortalRefs.name: CalPERS PE Fund Performance
lpPortalRefs.notes: Public HTML table. IRR, TVPI, committed capital by fund name. Best available free source.

lpPortalRefs.name: WSIB Quarterly Investment Report
lpPortalRefs.notes: PDF, ~200 pages. Private markets section lists fund names, committed $ and market value. Look for "Private Equity" and "Infrastructure" appendix tables.

lpPortalRefs.name: Oregon Treasury Alternative Investments
lpPortalRefs.notes: Lists fund vintage, committed capital, called capital, distributions, NAV. One of the best US LP sources for infrastructure fund detail.

lpPortalRefs.name: Rhode Island State Treasury
lpPortalRefs.notes: Fund-level TVPI and DPI available. Search for specific GP names.

lpPortalRefs.name: TRS Texas Quarterly Investment Report
lpPortalRefs.notes: Massive LP. Private Infrastructure and Private Equity sections show committed/market value.

lpPortalRefs.name: Preqin AWS Marketplace (Infrastructure Investors)
lpPortalRefs.notes: Free AWS Marketplace dataset. LP-side infrastructure investor profiles. Not fund-level GP data, but useful for commitment cross-reference.

lpPortalRefs.name: SEC EDGAR Form D Bulk Data
lpPortalRefs.notes: Six TSV files: OFFERING.tsv has totalOfferingAmount and totalAmountSold per filing. SUBMITTER.tsv has filer name. Best for tracking fund closes and raise amounts. Use accessionNumber to cross-reference.
